overview: Ajax had 126,666 residents in 2021, up 5.8% from 119,677 in 2016, living in 39,488 occupied homes on just 66.64 square kilometres. That makes it one of the denser suburban markets east of Toronto, with most customers a short drive from any storefront.

Because the town is compact and well served by highways and transit, residents can easily shop in Pickering, Whitby or Toronto instead. Local businesses need to give people a clear reason to stay close to home.

byService.lead-generation: Ajax packs 39,488 households into a small area, so lead generation can target tight service radii and still reach a large pool of nearby customers.
byService.seo: Since Ajax shoppers can just as easily choose Pickering or Whitby, SEO should target town and neighbourhood terms such as Pickering Village to keep searches local.
byService.website-development: For a dense commuter town of 126,666 people, a website that loads quickly on phones and shows hours, location and booking up front will convert more visits.
byService.branding: Ajax grew 5.8% between 2016 and 2021, and a brand that feels rooted in the community helps a business stand out from the chains along the highway corridor.
